intent.objective: Prepare a governed handoff from Invoke to Sigil Development so ontology-vault can be updated to support generic project-local runtime profiles and optional governed-agent runtime backends.

subagent_strategy.explanation: This Invoke route only writes a handoff packet. Future agent-backed runtime pilots must route through domainspec-subagents-strategy after Sigil Development updates the ontology-vault contract.

steps.name: Select source context for ontology-vault runtime-profile update
stop_conditions: block if selected context cannot distinguish canonical ontology-vault sources from generated runtime mirrors
block if selected context would require private DomainSpec v2 details to be written into public arcanum as-is

steps.name: Author Sigil Development handoff packet
stop_conditions: block if the handoff mutates ontology-vault instead of routing to sigil-development
block if the handoff claims DomainSpec v2 ontology candidates are promoted knowledge

steps.name: Consume handoff and update ontology-vault lifecycle

outputs.ref: future Sigil Development result for ontology-vault --update

stop_conditions: block if Sigil Development hardcodes private DomainSpec v2 paths into the public generic sigil contract
block if generated .agents or .claude mirrors are edited as the source of truth
block promotion readiness until experiment-harness and observability state are addressed

gates.condition: Invoke authors only the handoff packet; Sigil Development owns ontology-vault mutation, validation, observability, reflection, and promotion readiness.
Private DomainSpec v2 pilot details remain in private handoff/profile surfaces and are not copied verbatim into public arcanum sources.
Project-local runtime profile outputs are evidence, validation reports, projections, and read models; they are not owner decisions or canonical source mutations.
Any future agent-backed runtime pilot requires P1 trigger, check-tension gate, explicit human confirmation, dispatch registration, and closeout.
Canonical ontology-vault sources are patched first; generated runtime skill mirrors are synced only after canonical validation.

boundaries.contract: Invoke provides selected context and a handoff packet; Sigil Development consumes it before any ontology-vault update.
Only generic runtime-profile concepts may move into public ontology-vault; private pilot paths stay in private profile artifacts.
Ontology Vault may recommend an agent backend, but subagent dispatch lifecycle and ledger rules remain owned by domainspec-subagents-strategy.

authority.execution: task-session or domainspec-subagents-strategy only after later approval
authority.validation: dispatch-spec, sigil-development, experiment-harness, and path-scoped checks
authority.evidence: context-builder selected sources and future runtime receipts
authority.memory: inventory only after owner review, not from this handoff
authority.promotion: project owner, decision-gate, definitions-governance, or relevant authority route

state_namespaces.write_policy: Invoke may write this private handoff packet here.
Sigil Development may later patch generic canonical sigil sources only.
Sync from canonical after validation; do not treat as source authority.
Create runtime profile only in a later bounded task-session or owner-approved route.

promotion_splits.source: execution evidence from runtime profile or agent backend
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and cannot move automatically from runtime result to canonical knowledge
extract generic profile behavior only; private paths remain outside public canonical sources

validation: selected sources map to handoff obligations
native_stage_receipts.handoff_note: Context is sufficient for a non-execution Sigil Development handoff.

native_stage_receipts.residue: Sigil Development must decide exact profile flag syntax and experiment harness changes.

promotion_guardrails: Do not turn private DomainSpec v2 profile details into public generic sigil law.
Do not treat runtime profile output as an owner decision.
Do not treat agent consensus as authority.
Do not patch generated runtime skill mirrors as source authority.
